integrity_policy.symlinks: SHA256SUMS lists regular files only and excludes symlinks so sha256sum/shasum -c works. Link target bytes, SHA-256, type and target are recorded in engineering_source.symlinks and upstream inventory; ZIP integrity independently verifies target bytes and Unix symlink attributes.
